rebar-debug Phase 1 / Stage 1 evidence dossier (2026-07-27):

Observed report and runtime:
- Gerrit change 986 patchset 1 is NEW at revision d51c056d0b4859d1a5fcb311b311c4e531919078. Public Gerrit REST records LLM-Review +1 by rebar-review-bot at 2026-07-27 22:58:53 UTC, zero unresolved comments, and the commit message contains `rebar-ticket: 9447-b31c-e0b7-446d`. `/review/health` returns `{"status":"ok"}`.
- The shared tracker has 85 code_review tickets, but zero code_review tickets match the revision; `rebar audit show 9447-b31c-e0b7-446d` reports `code_reviews: []`; the Change-Id has zero search hits. The revision has two search hits only because it is quoted in the story/bug text.
- The newest Gerrit-shaped artifact (`code-review: I… @ <revision>`) was created at 1783832480571739905; no later live Gerrit artifact is present, although local `session:` artifacts continue.

Repository and history:
- `voter.py:730` calls `emit_code_review_artifact(..., repo_root=None)` only after a confirmed vote. The emitter creates/reuses the artifact, emits the v2 sidecar, resolves trailers, and swallows any outer exception while emitting `ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR` (`voter.py:260-367`).
- Commit d09e9c35c added `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh`, installs/calls it from `Dockerfile.reviewbot`, and tests that a fresh tickets clone gains repo-local identity plus `.env-id`; it also added the greppable error marker.
- Commit 79a10387a added compose `GIT_CONFIG_*` safe.directory for `/var/gerrit/site/reviewbot-tickets` after live logs proved persistent-volume ownership blocked all artifact writes. Ticket a698 records a successful 2026-07-16 redeploy and zero markers after deploy, but explicitly says no fresh vote occurred, so end-to-end artifact creation was not observed.
- Current compose sets `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/reviewbot-tickets`, `REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always`, the safe.directory override, and the named persistent volume. Current origin/main is dcc90ced4 and the debug worktree is clean at that SHA.

Access/unknowns:
- The production host is SSM-only in AWS account 896586841071. Available CLI credentials resolve to accounts 820258254566 and 579718921998, so host journald/container inspection is not currently possible. Exact `ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR` text, deployed SHA, container env, volume state, ensure output, and tracker git state remain unknown.

Parked leads for Stage 2 (not conclusions): deployed revision/image drift; ensure runs before a deferred clone then is never retried; persistent clone later loses a required writable-store invariant; runtime env/path mismatch; store write succeeds locally but sync/push/reconciliation loses the artifact.
